in_sanskrit.name: एकान्श
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name 'Ekansh' is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Eka' meaning one and 'Ansh' meaning part or form. The name can be translated as 'One Hundred One' or 'The One who forms a hundred'. In Hindu mythology, the name is associated with Lord Shiva, who is believed to be the creator of the universe and all living beings.
